# TIP TOP Food Tech India Pvt. Ltd.

> TIP TOP Food Tech is a trusted snacks manufacturer in Delhi with 35+ years of experience (founded 1991 by Mr. Suresh Chand Goyal). We manufacture namkeen, chips, extruded snacks, popcorn, fryums, and private-label snack products, distributed across 25+ states and 25+ cities in India, with OEM partnerships with brands such as Haldiram's, Bikanervala, Yellow Diamond, 24Seven, and Babaji.

## Company

- [About Us](https://www.tiptopfoodtech.com/#about): Company history, founder, milestones (35+ years, 25+ states, 25+ operational cities, 100+ product variants).
- [Why Choose Us](https://www.tiptopfoodtech.com/#why-us): Quality standards, manufacturing capability, and reasons businesses partner with us.
- [Testimonials](https://www.tiptopfoodtech.com/#testimonials): Feedback from retail distributors, institutional buyers, and customers.
- [FAQ](https://www.tiptopfoodtech.com/#faq): Common questions about our manufacturing, private labeling, certification, and ordering process.
- [Contact](https://www.tiptopfoodtech.com/#contact): Registered office, works/unit addresses, phone, and email.

## Products

- [Products](https://www.tiptopfoodtech.com/#products): Chatori Katori, Rings Masala, Jeera Papad, Ghapa Ghap, Crispy Pasta, Kurrey Masala, and custom/private-label snacks.

## Partnerships

- [OEM Partners](https://www.tiptopfoodtech.com/#oem): Haldiram's, Bikanervala, Yellow Diamond, 24Seven, Babaji.
- [Institutional Retail Partners](https://www.tiptopfoodtech.com/#partners): Kendriya Bhandar, Central Police Canteen, Northern Railway, NAFED, IRCTC, HAFED.
